_about: Every voice-over line in Aqua Energizer. make_voices.bat reads this file. 'set' is base (already recorded) or story (the story script). Words in [brackets] are ElevenLabs audio tags: they set the delivery and are not spoken. Script by character: docs/voice-script.md.

audition.narrator: [softly] Deep in the sea, the reef glows with magic pearls. [gently] But one little diver turns on a light.
audition.diver: [determined] Then he’ll see us coming. With our lights on. [laughs] Boing, boing, whoa-ho-ho!
audition.pip: [excited, breathless] Whoa, whoa, WHOA! Somebody just woke a gate! [nervous] I’m not scared. My fins are just cold.
audition.shelly: [slow, gravelly] Red eyes, you say? Hmph. Then my old bones were right. [fierce] And I have two hundred years of anger.
audition.clack: [booming, pompous] HALT! Who goes there? [proudly] Captain Clack, at your service! Nobody pinches pearls on MY reef!
audition.mira: [serene] I am Mira. The canyon is wide, and grief is heavy. I will carry both.
audition.cousin: [shrieking with joy] Pip! PIP! Shelly woke up! [giggling] Last one in is a sea slug!
audition.lumen: [theatrical, grand] Lumen’s the name, light’s the game! [stage whisper] Shh. Sleeping piranhas. Tippy-tippy-toe.
audition.murk: [deep, whispering, broken] Please… don’t be afraid. [resolute] I won’t be afraid again.
audition.grimtide: [silky, amused] Thank you for the map, little light. [menacing whisper] I’ll be waiting at every gate. [laughs darkly]
audition.snip: [sneering] Well, well. A little light! [cackling] Ooh, flat as a flounder!
audition.snap: [snarling] Boss says nobody leaves the Shallows! [snarling laugh] Thanks for the snack!
audition.keeper: [gentle, like a memory] If you’re hearing this, someone found my first coin. Hello, little diver.

lines.text: [softly] Deep in the sea, the reef glows with magic pearls.
lines.when: Intro film: the reef at night

lines.text: [a little worried] One night, a huge storm hits the reef…
…and sweeps all the pearls away. [whispers] The reef goes dark.
lines.when: Intro film: the lights blow away

lines.text: [gently] But one little diver turns on a light.
lines.when: Intro film: the helmet lamp clicks on

lines.text: Swim into the sand to dig a tunnel.
The tunnel reaches the gate. Now get behind the red pearl…
lines.when: Intro film: diver above the gate

lines.text: [excited] …and push it to the gate!
[amazed] The gate wakes up, and the light comes back!
Twenty-nine gates are still dark. [warmly] Can you wake them all?
This is you. Swim, dig and push your way to the gate.
This red pearl is full of light. The gate needs it.
Push the pearl in to wake the gate, then swim in yourself.
Air starts on your first move, so look around first. Finish before it runs out!
Swipe to swim. Swim into sand to dig through it.
Use the arrow keys to swim. Swim into sand to dig through it.
Take the sand away under a stone, and it falls.
[gently] Never stand right under a stone!
Falling stones and pearls roll off round things, and they roll left first.
[a little worried] It patrols the water, and charges the moment it sees you.
[playfully] Drop a stone on it to stop it for good.
It drifts up and down its shaft. Cross when it is far away.
It scuttles back and forth. Stay out of its path!
[brightly] Swim into it for forty-five more seconds of air.
[warmly] Deeper now. Welcome to the Coral Caves. [softly] Plan before you dig.
[hushed] This is The Deep. Only the bravest divers come this far.
[cheerfully] Today's dive is the same for every diver. Ready? Go!
[amazed] Every gate is awake. The whole reef is glowing again!
[warmly] Thank you, little diver. The Glow Reef shines because of you.
[excited] Woohoo! The light's back!
Gate's awake. Onward!
[giggles] Easy as bubbles!
[sighs] Oof… let's try that again.
[determined] Hold on, I've got this!
[happy] Got one!
One more!
[giggles] In you go!
[excited] It's open!
Yes! Let's go!
[gasps] Ooh, treasure!
[giggles] Bonk!
[excited] Double!
[relieved] Phew!
That was close!
[nervous] I need air!
Whoops!
[playfully] Wait, wait… one more time!
[softly, amazed] The first gate wakes. Its light races into an old pipe… and takes you with it.
[excited, breathless] Whoa, whoa, WHOA! Somebody just woke a gate!
[excited] Nobody’s done that since the storm. Nobody! Who ARE you?
[warm, curious] Just a diver with a lamp. Who are you?
[giggles] I’m Pip! And you… you’re a spark. I’m calling you Spark.
[hushed, ominous] Far away, in the dark, two red eyes open.
[wistful] See this? I used to glow like a lantern. Then the storm came.
[scared, whispering] It wasn’t a normal storm, Spark. It had eyes. Red ones.
[gently] Storms don’t have eyes, Pip.
[trembling] This one did. And it was hungry. It ate every light in the reef.
[excited] But when your gate woke… look! I sparkled! Just a little!
[determined, smiling] Then let’s wake another one. And another.
[slow, gravelly] Red eyes, you say? Hmph. Then my old bones were right.
[grave] His name is Grimtide. An eel as long as a shipwreck, who drinks light.
[bitter] Every season he took his tribute: our brightest pearls, or he’d take everything.
[proud] The Reef Keeper said no. She built thirty gates and drove him into the abyss.
[small, scared voice] And… now he’s back?
[urgent] Now he’s back. And you just woke his gates. Hop on, little ones. Quickly.
[booming, pompous] HALT! Who goes there? State your name and your business!
[amused] Uh… a diver? Waking gates?
[proud] Gate-wakers! Crew, stand down! Captain Clack, at your service!
[dramatic] We dug these pearls out of the sand. Grimtide’s tail dragged off the rest. Thick as a mast, it was!
[heroic] The Crack Crab Crew sails with you. Nobody pinches pearls on MY reef!
[whispering, amused] Is he… always this loud?
[shouting proudly] ALWAYS!
[warm] The jellies hum whenever a gate wakes. Five gates, and now they’re singing.
[excited] They want to help! Jump, Spark! Jump!
[laughing] Boing… boing… whoa-ho-HO!
[flustered] Steady there! A captain never bounces without permission!
[curious] From the top of the jelly stair you see a shipwreck. And something glinting inside.
[hushed] Inside the wreck sits a chest with a seashell clasp.
[excited, nervous] Open it! Open it! No, wait, what if it bites? Open it!
[amazed] Inside: a map of all thirty gates, drawn in the Reef Keeper’s own hand.
[gentle, like a memory] “If Grimtide ever returns, wake the gates. Shared light is the one thing he cannot drink.”
[thrilled] A treasure map! Every captain’s dream!
[happy] With this we’ll never get lost. Not ever!
[curious] In a dark hollow, a soft light glows. A gate? It looks just like one.
[nervous] Spark, wait. Gates don’t flicker like that…
[urgent] The light snaps shut. It was a lure! The water explodes into ink!
[silky, amused] Thank you for the map, little light. I know where every gate is now.
[menacing whisper] Wake them if you like. I’ll be waiting at every one.
[crying softly] Spark… my glow. It’s going out again.
[straining, through gritted teeth] Let… GO!
lines.when: Chapter 7 · The Lure — after “Hold on to the map!” (done in time)

lines.text: [tense] The map tears in two. A torn piece drifts away into the dark.
lines.when: Chapter 7 · The Lure — after “Hold on to the map!” (done in time)

lines.text: [desperate] No! The map!
lines.when: Chapter 7 · The Lure — after “Hold on to the map!” (missed)

lines.text: [tense] Grimtide rips it free. A torn corner drifts away into the dark.
lines.when: Chapter 7 · The Lure — after “Hold on to the map!” (missed)

lines.text: [sniffling] This is all my fault. I should’ve seen it was a trap.
[softly] Hey. You DID see it. You warned me. I didn’t listen.
[blustering] Chins up, crew! A captain doesn’t need a map. A captain needs… uh…
[wonder] The fish remember the gates. They swirl together into a silver arrow.
[triumphant] …FISH! A captain needs fish! Exactly as I planned!
[laughing through tears] They’re showing us the way! Hah! Who needs his map?
[curious] On top of the great dune, something flutters in the sand.
[excited] The torn piece of the map! It drifted all the way here!
[thoughtful] It shows one gate. The last gate of the Shallows… on the edge of a cliff.
[grumbling] Cliffs. I hate cliffs. Crabs don’t fall well.
[ominous] Behind the dune, ink hangs in the water. Fresh ink.
[whispering] He was here. Not long ago.
[awed] The map ends at a cliff. Far below, the Coral Caves glow violet in the dark.
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows

lines.text: [scared] Grimtide went down there. What if he’s waiting for us?
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows

lines.text: [determined] Then he’ll see us coming. With our lights on.
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows

lines.text: [sneering] Oh, he’s waiting all right!
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows

lines.text: [snarling laugh] And the boss says nobody leaves the Shallows!
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows

lines.text: [yelling, fading away] Crabs… don’t… fall… WELLLL!
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows

lines.text: [shouting] Pip, hold on! JUMP!
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows — after “Dive!” (done in time)

lines.text: [screaming] Aaah! They’re biting! Jump, jump, JUMP!
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows — after “Dive!” (missed)

lines.text: [hushed] The Coral Caves. Your lamp wakes the crystals, one by one.
[echoing, amused] Little light… you came all the way down here. For me?
[panicking] He can see us! Spark, he can SEE us!
[echoing whisper] Every crystal you light shows me where you are. So shine. Shine for me.
[calm, brave] Let him look, Pip. We didn’t come here to hide.
[brave, flustered] Aye! We came to pinch! Er… to win. To win.
[gently] Giant clams open, one by one, and sing the Keeper’s old song.
[singing softly] “Share your light, and the light comes home…”
[sad] But the last clam stays shut. Its pearl was stolen.
[sad] He took its song too. That’s the saddest thing I’ve ever seen.
[quiet promise] Then we bring it back. Every pearl. Every song.
[warm but worried] Brave words. Keep them close, little one. You’ll need them soon.
[tense] The water turns black. The storm has found you.
[roaring] Thirteen gates, little light? That’s thirteen too many!
[shouting, commanding] Everyone behind me! NOW!
[slow, grave] Shelly takes the whole blow on her old shell…
[whispered, heartbroken] …and sinks, slowly, to the sand.
[cold, quiet] One down.
[straining] I’ve got you, Pip! Don’t let go!
lines.when: Chapter 13 · The Dark Storm — after “Hold on to Pip!” (done in time)

lines.text: [screaming] Spark! I can’t hold on!
lines.when: Chapter 13 · The Dark Storm — after “Hold on to Pip!” (missed)

lines.text: [crying] Shelly? Shelly, please… wake up…
[weak, trying to smile] Hush now. My shell’s seen worse storms than that. Mostly.
[weak, sad] But I can’t swim on with you. Not this time.
[weak, earnest] Promise me you’ll wake every gate. Every last one.
[holding back tears] I promise, Shelly.
[gruff, emotional] Go. I’ll stand guard. Nobody touches this turtle while Clack has claws.
[tender] The glimmer jellies gather round her, glowing softly, to keep her warm.
[somber] With heavy hearts, you swim on. At the Great Canyon, a manta waits.
[serene] I am Mira. The currents carried me a message from an old turtle.
[serene, tender] She said: “Don’t look back. Tell them I’m proud.”
[sniffling, hopeful] She’s… proud of us?
[warm] Climb on, little ones. The canyon is wide, and grief is heavy. I will carry both.
[determined, soft] Fifteen gates. This one’s for you, Shelly.
[ominous] Deep in the caves, something huge blinks in the dark.
[terrified whisper] Spark… there are EYES. Big ones. Bigger than Shelly!
[hushed] A giant octopus, its arms bound in chains of ink.
[whispering, broken] Please… don’t be afraid. He makes me gather the pearls. I don’t want to.
[startled whisper] That lamp… Where did you get that lamp?
[tense] Before you can answer, a cruel tail drags him back into the black.
[curious] An old coral arch blocks the way. Its lamps went dark in the storm.
[ancient, echoing] “Grimtide fears one thing: light that is given away.”
[puzzled] Given away? But he TAKES light. He never gives it.
[realizing, excited] That’s it, Pip. That’s how we beat him. And how we free that octopus.
[laughing] You’re crazy. I love it.
[excited] You did it! The arch remembers the light!
lines.when: Chapter 17 · The Arch’s Secret — after “Light the lamps!” (done in time)

lines.text: [gentle] One by one, the old lamps flicker awake on their own.
lines.when: Chapter 17 · The Arch’s Secret — after “Light the lamps!” (missed)

lines.text: [wonder] Pearls float up from the sand like lanterns, a trail leading deeper.
[excited] The octopus dropped them! He’s helping us. In secret!
[faint, distant whisper] This way… hurry… before he notices…
[determined] Hold on, big guy. We’re coming for you.
[suspicious, cold, distant] Murk… What are you doing, Murk?
[bright] Pip’s cousins race in from the Shallows, glowing with news.
[shrieking with joy] Pip! PIP! Shelly woke up! She’s going to be okay!
[overjoyed, happy tears] She’s okay? She’s OKAY! Spark, she’s okay!
[giggling] And the loud crab says he’s coming to find you. Quote: “Don’t start without me!”
[laughing] Ha! Wouldn’t dream of it, Captain.
[excited] Nineteen gates! Come on, come on, faster!
[awed] From the last cliff of the caves, you see it at last: the Great Lantern.
[ominous] And coiled around it like a storm cloud lies Grimtide.
[delighted, menacing] Twenty gates. Twenty little lights, all lit… just for me.
[laughs darkly] You think you’re saving the reef? You’re setting the table.
[frightened] Spark… what does he mean?
[uneasy, determined] I don’t know. But we’re not stopping now.
[hushed] The Deep. Where the sun has never reached.
[stage whisper] Psst! Over here! Quick, before his eyes find you!
[theatrical, grand] Lumen’s the name, light’s the game! The Deep’s last lantern, at your service!
[dropping the act, scared] Truth is, I’ve been hiding for weeks. He hunts every glow down here.
[brave, theatrical] But you’re going after him? Then my little light is yours. Showtime!
[whispering, delighted] I like him.
[wonder] High above, a whale sings for the first time since the storm.
[thrilled] Old Bellow! He only sings when the Lantern fights back!
[booming] Did somebody say CAPTAIN? Clack, reporting for duty!
[overjoyed] CLACK! You came!
[proud, chuckling] A captain never leaves his crew. Shelly sends her love. And a very rude message for Grimtide.
[ominous] Far below, an angry roar shakes the Deep.
[hushed] An old sea city sleeps in the dark. On its last wall, a mural.
[awed] The Reef Keeper and a great purple octopus, driving Grimtide into the abyss.
[solemn] That octopus is Murk. The Keeper’s best friend.
[stunned whisper] Spark… look at her helmet. Look at her LAMP.
[shaken, quiet] It’s… my lamp. It’s the same lamp.
[soft, amazed] Then the light didn’t find you by accident, kid.
[joyful] Your gate wakes, and for one moment everything shines.
[joyful] Twenty-four! We’re going to make it, Spark! We’re actually going to…
[roaring] ENOUGH!
[screaming, fading] Spaaark! Heeelp!
[roaring, charging] Let him go, you overgrown noodle!
[slow, grave] Clack leaps at the tail. One mighty pinch… and the tail swats him into the dark.
[cold, triumphant] Come to my lair, little light. Bring me the last gates. Or never see him again.
[desperate] I’ve got you! I’ve got… NO!
lines.when: Chapter 24 · Ambush — after “Grab Pip!” (done in time)

lines.text: [screaming] PIP!
[heartbroken] In the sand lies a battered shell. A tiny captain’s hat beside it.
[weak, rasping] Gate-waker… did I get him? Tell me I pinched him good.
[crying] You got him, Captain. You got him good.
[weak, fading] Then tell my crew… they were the finest crew… on the whole… reef.
[whispered] And the Captain is still.
[firm, warm] Did someone call for an old turtle?
[grieving] Oh… oh, Clack. You brave, loud, wonderful fool.
[fierce] Wipe your eyes, little one. Grimtide has Pip. And I have two hundred years of anger.
[tense] In a den of stolen pearls hangs a cage, with Pip inside. Murk, in chains, guards it.
[crying, joyful] Spark! You came! I knew you’d come!
[ashamed, deep] I’m sorry. He makes me guard him. If I let him go, Grimtide will…
[gentle] Murk. This was her lamp, wasn’t it? The Keeper’s.
[breaking] …She was my best friend. I’ve been so afraid since she was gone.
[joyful roar] Free… I’m FREE! Hold on, little seahorse!
[ecstatic] Best. Rescue. EVER!
[soaring] You hold up a glowing pearl and give it away. The ink chains melt.
lines.when: Chapter 26 · Breaking the Chains — after “Give your light!” (done in time)

lines.text: [soaring] The pearl’s light pours out on its own, and the ink chains melt.
lines.when: Chapter 26 · Breaking the Chains — after “Give your light!” (missed)

lines.text: [deep, steady] Climb on. I know the way to his lair.
[epic] Murk carries you over the deepest trench in the sea.
[quiet, ashamed] The night of the storm, the Keeper went to face him alone. I was too afraid to follow.
[resolute] I won’t be afraid again.
[brave, shaky] Neither will I. Okay, a little. But I’m going anyway!
[warm] That’s what brave is, Pip.
[theatrical, grand] Ladies and gentlefish! Wave those arms, Spark! Show the Deep it isn’t alone!
[building] Every wave sets the plankton glowing. Then the jellies. Then the fish.
[proud, emotional] Clack’s crew raise his tiny hat high, their claws shining.
[moved] Everyone who ever hid from Grimtide. All of them, shining for you.
[triumphant] Twenty-eight gates… and a whole sea behind us!
[distant, mocking] Light them all, little light. It only makes my feast sweeter.
[tense] At the foot of the Great Lantern, Grimtide waits, the Heart Pearl in his coils.
[silky] You did it, little light. Twenty-nine gates. The Lantern is nearly full.
[hungry, rising] Wake the last one, and the Heart will blaze. And then I drink it ALL.
[horrified] That’s why he let us… We’ve been lighting his dinner!
[calm, defiant] You’re wrong about one thing. That light isn’t yours. We’re giving it away.
[menacing whisper] Then come, Keeper’s child. Let’s see who shines last.
[roaring] Not this time, Grimtide!
lines.when: Chapter 29 · Grimtide’s Lair — after “Dodge!” (done in time)

lines.text: [roaring] Spark! I’ve got you!
[epic] The last gate wakes. Thirty beams of light rush to the Lantern.
[greedy, ecstatic] Yes… YES! Give it to me!
[soaring] Every creature in the sea gives its light at once. Too much light, freely given.
[screaming] No… NO! It burns! It BURNS!
[triumphant, amused] All the light he stole pours out of him… and the great eel shrinks to a tiny, wriggling worm.
[satisfied] That’s for my shell.
[deep, quiet] And that’s for the Keeper.
[fierce, tearful] And THAT’S for Captain Clack!
[warm, soaring] The Heart Pearl rises home. And for the first time since the storm, the whole reef shines.
[shouting] It was never yours!
lines.when: Chapter 30 · The Reef’s Revenge — after “Give the light away!” (done in time)

lines.text: [shouting] Everybody, NOW! Give it away!
lines.when: Chapter 30 · The Reef’s Revenge — after “Give the light away!” (missed)

lines.text: [gently] Dig into the sand. Push the red pearl into the gate.
[excited] The gate is awake! Swim in!
[urgent, cheeky] Psst, Spark! Stones fall if you dig under them. Don’t be under them!
[giggling] Ooh, I felt that! My glow tickles!
[overjoyed] Two gates! Look, look, I’m sparkling!
[nervous, fast] A giant eel who drinks light… Nope. Not thinking about it. Digging!
[scared whisper] Did… did something just blink out there?
[warm, dry] Well done, little one. Now swim in, before my old bones get cold.
[booming] Crew! Escort the gate-waker! Eyes sharp, claws sharper!
[proud] A fine push! I taught you that. I didn’t. But I would have.
[cheeky] Four gates! Take that, Grimtide!
[sneering] Well, well. A little light. Snap, look! A snack!
[fierce] Don’t listen to them, Spark! Drop a stone on them!
[triumphant] HA! Five gates! Hear that? The jellies are singing!
[focused] Jellyfish float up and down. Wait for the gap… then go!
[wise, pompous] Patience, gate-waker. A good captain waits for the tide.
[excited] Six! The wreck is right there!
[careful] The map says this gate has a keystone. Careful where you dig.
[dreamy] Spark… do you see that glow over there? It’s so pretty…
[silky whisper] Yes, little light. Come and see the pretty glow…
[sniffling] My glow is so faint… Stay close to me, okay?
[blustering] No map, no problem! I have an excellent sense of direction. Mostly.
[amazed] We found it without the map! We actually did it!
[whispering] Ink everywhere… He came this way.
[distant, amused] I can smell your little lamp from here.
[excited] Nine! The torn map piece is close. I can feel it!
[snarling] Last gate of the Shallows, little light. Shame you won’t reach it.
[cackling] Boss says hurry it up, Snap! Shake the tank!
[scared, brave] Ten gates. Hold my fin, Spark. Here comes the cliff…
[echoing whisper] Little light… turn back.
[defiant] Every crystal we light, he sees us. So let’s light them ALL.
[cheeky] Eleven! Ha! He can echo all he likes!
[calm, slow] Breathe slow, little one. Air is precious this deep.
[soft] That pearl is for the silent clam. I just know it.
[uneasy] Twelve. Why does the water feel so heavy?
[scared] Something’s wrong. The water’s going dark…
[menacing, close] I’m coming for you, little light.
[urgent] Swim in, quickly! Something huge is coming!
[quiet, sad] Shelly would want us to keep going. So we keep going.
[distant, shouting] She’s sleeping sound, gate-waker! I’ve got her!
[soft, tearful] Fourteen. Rest well, Shelly.
[determined] For Shelly. Let’s go!
[serene] Steady, little one. Every gate you wake reaches her too.
[happy, tearful] Fifteen gates! She’d be so proud of us.
